verdict.what_is_wrong: A new CPU-bound workload, stress-ng-cpu, competed with existing workloads; the app process (PID 131904) showed more CPU waiting while it ran. The workload was confined to a distinct container and was active for about two minutes, then disappeared. The later multi-event rate rise near 13:21:44 is not the onset: it coincides with this workload ending and is not attributed to a new source.
